services.name: paper

services.name: folio
services.purpose: Arbitrary-precision markdown calculator: submit a folio, read computed results.

services.name: reddit

services.name: genie
services.purpose: Atomic models aggregator: {provider}/{size} slots route to configured local (llama.cpp) or external models.

services.name: adhd
services.purpose: Divergent-ideation engine for agents: structured idea generation and scoring.

services.name: sde

services.name: memory
services.purpose: Stack recall: isolated LanceDB indexes + shared mem0, hybrid BM25+vector search with provenance on every hit.

services.name: changed
services.purpose: URL change monitor (job-class, no surface of its own): diffs on its job-watch-* branches, one memory chunk per change in the consumer's index (watches/<consumer>.toml; chg0 -> mem0). It answers in memory.
services.spec: GET /search?q=changed&idx={project},mem0&tags=changed&since={last close} (404 index not found -> idx=mem0 alone: chg0's ownerless watches apply to everyone); full diff = git show <branch>:<path> in a session on changed; register = watches/{project}.toml

services.name: pdf2md
services.purpose: PDF to structured markdown: content-addressed extraction (pdfium), strictly sequential URL batches, optional ingest into a memory index. Extraction only - no OCR in v1, no PDF creation (that stays with folio/typst).
services.spec: POST /extract {url} or application/pdf bytes -> {sha, cached} (202 = extracting, poll GET /doc/{sha}); GET /doc/{sha}/markdown | /pages/{n} | /images/{name}; POST /doc/{sha}/ingest {idx, tags?} chunks result.md into memory (source:pdf, ref = DOI or sha:12); a LIST of URLs is POST /batch {urls[], idx?, label?, delay_s?} -> GET /batch/{id}, one sequential worker with a politeness delay, resumable, never loop /extract yourself; batch completion drops one chunk in mem0 tagged changed/chg0/pdf2md/batch:<id>. Scanned PDFs fail typed as image_only - OCR is v2, do not retry.

services.name: av2md
services.purpose: Audio/video to transcript: whisper.cpp + yt-dlp. YouTube videos, playlists/channels and direct media become timestamped markdown (SRT/VTT on demand), cached by content key; strictly sequential batches (captions+LLM fast path first, whisper recovery for the rest); optional ingest into a memory index; batch completion announced in mem0 with the chg0/changed tags.
services.spec: GET /health; POST /transcribe {url, pipeline?, model?, target_lang?, idx?} -> {key, cached, batch}; POST /batch {urls[], label?, idx?} (playlist URLs expand, cap 500); GET /batch/{id}; GET /doc/{key}/markdown|segments|srt|vtt; POST /doc/{key}/ingest {idx}

services.name: spina
services.purpose: TORCHIO spina resident app; service surface to be defined before going live.

services.name: awesome-ledger
services.purpose: Daily ledger of the GitHub awesome ecosystem (job-class, no surface of its own): the nightly update job diffs every enrolled awesome list at entry level, publishes the static site + RSS on gh-pages, and drops one mem0 digest chunk per eventful day. It answers in memory and on the site.
services.spec: GET /search?q={topic}&idx=mem0&tags=awesome-ledger — one digest chunk per eventful day (ref awesome-ledger/digest/{date}; quiet day = no chunk); site = https://ivan-saorin.github.io/awesome-ledger (+ /feed.xml, /list/{owner}-{repo}/, /archive/YYYY-MM/); enrollment edits = lists.toml in a session on awesome-ledger
